Who are we?

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world's largest SAR constellation. Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from five international locations with over 600 employees from nearly 60 countries. Our shared vision is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Our satellites acquire images of Earth at any time—cloudy or dark conditions included—providing commercial and government partners with unmatched persistent monitoring capabilities. Data derived from our SAR images assists customers in making data-driven decisions to address time-critical challenges across sectors such as maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance.

Our team comprises experts across disciplines like engineering, software development, and radar technology. We are innovative, driven, and strive for excellence. Core values include teamwork, curiosity, and having fun, which help us make the impossible possible!

Why work with us?

ICEYE is at the forefront of new technology, continuously building and operating our commercial SAR satellite constellation. Joining ICEYE means contributing to industry-shaping innovations while working with diverse, engaged colleagues. We value our people highly, offering opportunities to influence the company's vision and direction.

We support continuous professional development through courses, training, and conference attendance. At ICEYE, your growth and success are priorities.

What will you do in this role?

  • Collaborate with the Senior Manager of Latin America to develop regional strategies, including identifying the best routes for ICEYE's services (federal, state, or local levels), and expanding key client accounts long-term.
  • Prospect key accounts to identify buyer personas and engage through warm and cold outreach.
  • Serve as the lead relationship manager for your accounts and primary contact points.

  • Support and develop proposals for government prospects alongside the Senior Manager Latin America.
  • Build internal relationships and liaise with the Product Team to ensure continuous delivery improvements.
  • Coordinate with marketing to generate leads and improve conversion rates from leads to sales.

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients.   • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.

Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. Strategic Workforce Planning Manager (Remote)

Join to apply for the Strategic Workforce Planning Manager (Remote) role at Bunge .

Position Mission
The mission of this role is to shape, lead, and embed strategic workforce planning as a core business capability, ensuring the organization has the right talent, skills, and structure to achieve its long-term business objectives. This position influences enterprise strategy through advanced workforce insights, close partnership with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and senior executives, and proactive solutions to complex workforce challenges.

Brief Description Of The Position
Lead enterprise-wide workforce strategy, partnering with HRBPs and senior leadership to forecast future talent needs, address workforce gaps, and align organizational capability with business priorities. Leverage advanced workforce analytics and predictive insights to influence decision-making, drive talent strategies, and optimize organizational performance.

Activities And Responsibilities

  • Develop, own, and continuously evolve long-term workforce planning strategies aligned with business strategy.
  • Partner with C-suite and senior leadership to ensure workforce planning drives business transformation and growth.
  • Embed workforce planning into enterprise planning cycles (strategic planning, budgeting, operational planning).

Collaboration with HRBPs and Business Leaders

  • Partner with HRBPs to integrate workforce planning into talent, succession, and organizational design strategies.
  • Translate business priorities into actionable workforce strategies at enterprise, functional, and regional levels.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment between HR, Finance, and business leadership on headcount planning, skills forecasting, and workforce costs.

Advanced Analytics & Workforce Insights

  • Lead advanced analytics, scenario modeling, and predictive forecasting to anticipate future skills, capacity, and talent requirements.
  • Translate complex workforce data into actionable insights for executives and business leaders.
  • Develop and oversee dashboards, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that inform enterprise decisions.

Talent Strategy & Future of Work

  • Identify emerging workforce gaps and design strategies for talent acquisition, reskilling, and retention.
  • Champion workforce agility and capability building in response to digital transformation, automation, and changing business models.
  • Monitor labor market and industry trends to proactively advise leadership on risks and opportunities.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Oversee workforce planning tools and ensure consistent, high-quality data inputs across the enterprise.
  • Establish governance frameworks and processes for workforce planning, ensuring compliance with regulatory, privacy, and internal standards.
  • Build organizational capability in workforce planning through training, frameworks, and best practices.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Strategic Workforce Alignment: Degree of alignment between workforce strategies and business priorities.
  • Forecast Accuracy: Precision of workforce projections and predictive models.
  • Executive Adoption: Integration of workforce insights into C-suite and senior-level decision-making.
  • Process Efficiency: Timeliness and cost-effectiveness of workforce planning processes.
  • Talent Readiness Metrics: Availability of critical skills and talent pipelines to meet business needs.

Main Opportunities and Decisions

  • Operates at the intersection of business strategy, HR strategy, and advanced analytics. Key challenges include anticipating disruptive workforce shifts, balancing cost efficiency with capability growth, and influencing executive priorities with data-driven insights. This role represents transformational leadership to guide the organization to be future-ready, agile, and resilient.

Key Relationships, Stakeholders & Interfaces (Internal & External)

  • HR Leadership
  • Business Leaders
  • HR Business Partners (HRBPs)
  • Finance and Controller
  • IT
  • Other cross-functional leaders as needed

Knowledge And Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance or related field; master’s preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic workforce planning, HR strategy/consulting, partnering with HRBPs and Finance to align talent plans with business goals.
  • Advanced analytical and forecasting skills (supply/demand, scenario modeling).
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder influence skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple portfolios and deliverables in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong project/program management and facilitation skills with a track record of driving adoption.
  • Strong attention to detail and data integrity; experience handling confidential information and adhering to compliance standards.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

description:
Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences. É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição da vaga

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;

  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;

  • Comunicar a necessidade de materiais e necessidade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, e quando necessário realizar as manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos seguindo as recomendações do fabricante e as orientações do Analista Sênior ou Coordenador;
  • Manter os freezers, geladeiras, armários, gavetas, prateleiras e bancadas organizados, mantendo cada insumo armazenado em temperatura preconizada pelo fabricante (ambiente, refrigerado ou congelado);
  • Limpar e desinfetar a área de trabalho (bancada) antes e depois da rotina, seguindo o procedimento específico;
  • Vistoriar mensalmente os insumos quanto à data de vencimento; informar o Coordenador do Setor com antecedência sobre o vencimento e realizar o descarte quando necessário;
  • Utilizar todos os EPIs necessários para a realização das tarefas com segurança e de acordo com as normas de segurança dos laboratórios;
  • Arquivar documentos de acordo com treinamento da qualidade;
  • Segregar e descartar os resíduos;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade, ou a critério de seu superior.

Necessário experiência com GC/MS ou ICP-OES/MS, de preferência em áreas ambientais.

Inglês intermediário – capaz de se comunicar e compreender, sem necessidade de fluência.

description:
A Igma é uma empresa de tecnologia que cria produtos digitais críticos — sites, plataformas e apps que funcionam, crescem e deixam marca. Overview

O que buscamos

Procuramos Scrum Master Pleno para facilitar e liderar a execução de sprints, focando na entrega constante de valor através de uma excelente gestão dos processos ágeis. Unimos design e tecnologia para resolver problemas complexos de empresas.

Criamos produtos digitais que revolucionam o relacionamento entre empresas e consumidores. Buscamos pessoas pró-ativas, com conhecimento e experiência em metodologias ágeis, que tenham forte capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento, que se adaptem a mudanças constantes e saibam facilitar e envolver a equipe para atingir seus objetivos.

Overview

Join TravelNet Solutions as a Project Manager!

At TravelNet Solutions (TNS), we combine deep hospitality expertise with forward-thinking technology and a customer-obsessed mindset… to help property managers win! TNS is proud to be named an Inc.5000 Fastest Growing Company in America.

This role is perfect for someone who is:

  • A self-starter with tremendous initiative and a strong work ethic
  • An excellent communicator and collaborator across functional teams
  • Eager to make a high impact at a product-driven company
  • Adaptable, quick to embrace change, and a fast learner
  • Skilled in creative and critical thinking
  • Detail-oriented, even in a fast-paced environment
  • Passionate about technology and innovation

About TravelNet Solutions

For over 21 years, TravelNet Solutions has provided integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, anchored by our flagship Track Property Management System and other products under the Track banner.

Our single-vendor ecosystem equips growing vacation rental companies with all the enterprise-class tools they need to scale. With ongoing investments in platform development, 70+ integration partners, and a growing list of native features, Track empowers hospitality professionals to achieve digital transformation and operational excellence.

Our Core Values

reflect the behaviors that shape the tone of how we work with each other, our partners, and our customers:

  • Serve Others: Nurturing growth to help others succeed
  • Grit: Taking ownership and never giving up on what matters most
  • Create the Future: Innovating to disrupt the status quo

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a fast-moving, dynamic team focused on growth and success.
  • Work alongside a talented, collaborative, and supportive team.
  • Work for a portfolio company offering a one-vendor solution for SaaS technology, marketing, and distribution.
  • Help reshape the hospitality industry through technology and service innovation.

Perks and Benefits

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Unlimited access to professional training and development
  • Health Savings Account with up to a $2,000 annual match
  • Flexible work environment
  • Free life insurance and long-term disability coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Retirement plan with employer match
  • Free snacks and soda in the office
  • $150 quarterly gift for personal use
  • Competitive wages
  • Work with an amazing team!

Summary and Responsibilities

Track is the industry leader in vacation rental property management software, trusted by property managers and resorts nationwide. As a Project Manager on our Professional Services team, you will lead the onboarding of clients onto Track’s award-winning SaaS platform.

In this client-facing role, you’ll own projects from kick-off through hand-off to our Customer Success team, ensuring a smooth and successful transition. You’ll guide property managers through critical software implementations, driving adoption while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth, customer-focused company where your work directly impacts client success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build trusted, strategic client relationships, positioning yourself as a partner and advisor.
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding project lifecycle, from contract signature to successful handoff.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, managing timelines, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Communicate proactively: provide clear, consistent updates to customers, leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Identify risks and roadblocks early, creating solutions that keep projects on track.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Implementation Consultants, Subject Matter Experts, Sales, Engineering, and Product teams to drive outcomes.
  • Ensure clients fully implement Track’s core functionality and are set up for long-term success.
  • Balance multiple priorities by managing 10–20 projects in varying phases simultaneously.
  • Deliver exceptional customer experiences that strengthen Track’s reputation as a trusted partner.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2–3 years of project management or account management experience, preferably in software onboarding or SaaS implementations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects with planning, risk management, and resource coordination.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to present and facilitate effectively.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Preferred: Experience in hospitality operations (resorts, vacation rentals, or property management).
  • Preferred: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Diversity and Inclusion

We celebrate diversity of thought, culture, and background and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law. We comply with all applicable laws governing nondiscrimination in every location where we operate and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation

The typical starting salary range for this position is: $70K to 82K. The actual salary offer will consider multiple factors, including skills, experience, education, and location. Please note that the salary reflects the base amount only and does not include total compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and benefits.

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry – Nexer Telescope

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry role at Nexer Telescope .

Sweden needs skilled engineers. About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. We currently have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description: As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are high by international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. You will be supported by a global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. You will also be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles relocation-related practical matters for our consultants. In short, we fix everything for our employees – visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it.

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team with a clear focus on helping engineers and their families build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope’s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Find engineers who are ready to relocate to Sweden and inform them about the benefits of living and working there.
  • Build trust with suitable candidates to facilitate relocation and hiring.
  • Collaborate with a global team of recruiters and the Swedish delivery management team to handle relocation logistics.
  • Coordinate with clients across software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well-proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service-oriented with a flexible mindset to find the best solution.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and IT outstaffing/outsourcing.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Knowledge of contemporary IT technologies and the ability to learn new technologies.
  • Analytical, well-organized with attention to detail, and able to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self-confident, social, friendly, and highly motivated.
  • Resilient and persistent, able to view a “no” as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success with an executive yet relaxed attitude toward work, colleagues, and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible with a professional appearance.

Extent & Duration: Start ASAP. Full-time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

description:
This range is provided by LawnStarter. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$60,000.00/yr - $70,000.00/yr

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule
  • Unlimited PTO — Focus on results. Take time you need to recharge or work hard when you return

LawnStarter is building the future of outdoor home services. Want to help us shape it?
Apply now and let's grow together.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Overview

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas , garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Que tal fazer parte de um time brilhante em uma startup com DNA de Fintech + Edtech que está transformando o futuro da educação no Brasil?

noisaac, vivemos desafios grandiosos e instigantes, construindo um produto totalmente do zero. Nosso ponto de partida é sempre a investigação profunda dos reais problemas de escolas e responsáveis, para então idealizar e colocar em prática soluções simples, escaláveis e de alto impacto.

Mais do que conhecimento técnico, valorizamos colaboração, abertura ao aprendizado e adaptabilidade para navegar na jornada de crescimento acelerado de um produto em constante evolução.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Traduzir os objetivos estratégicos da empresa em metas claras e acionáveis para o time;
  • Monitorar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria contínua, garantindo que o time atue de forma alinhada às necessidades do negócio;
  • Liderar projetos complexos, acompanhando métricas de sucesso e removendo impedimentos para o time;
  • Revisar e otimizar fluxos de trabalho para aumentar a produtividade da equipe;
  • Garantir alinhamento contínuo com Product Managers (PMs), Designers e outras áreas de interface;
  • Planejar e gerenciar a alocação de recursos do time, equilibrando carga de trabalho e competências individuais.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia em liderança técnica de equipes de engenharia de software.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de escalabilidade e impacto a longo prazo.
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash flexível - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Reembolso para evolução profissional (cursos, palestras, eventos, etc);
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vempraisaac

Join to apply for the Software Engineer III, Backend, QuickPack (Remote) role at Shippo

Here at Shippo, we are the shipping layer of the internet and we consider ourselves to be one of the core building blocks of e-commerce. Our mission is to make merchants successful through world class shipping. With our products and solutions, we level the playing field by providing our customers with best-in-class solutions that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them. Through Shippo, e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, and platforms are able to connect to shipping carriers around the world from one API and dashboard. We provide our customers with the most competitive shipping rates, print labels, automated international documents, shipment tracking, facilitate the returns process and more.

We are looking for a Software Engineer III to join our App team! In this role you will work closely with our front-end developers to build the next generation of our back-end services to support our growing business and new products.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and deploy high-volume backend services with high SLAs
  • Ensure scalability and maintainability through microservices, decoupled architectures, queuing, and containerized deployments
  • Enhance CI/CD pipelines for safe, automated, and reliable releases
  • Monitor and optimize performance for responsiveness and throughput
  • Refactor and architect system components for optimal performance and reuse
  • Participate in peer reviews, design discussions, and contribute to automated test suites
  • Provide technical insights in planning and review to streamline delivery
  • Participate in on-call rotation and respond quickly to incidents
  • Assist in gathering requirements and ensuring alignment from design through verification

Requirements

  • 4+ years of backend software development experience
  • Proven success building and supporting scalable APIs, services, or applications
  • Proficiency in server-side languages (Go, Python, Java, Ruby) and SQL
  • Experience with MVC frameworks (Django, .NET, Spring, Rails, Phoenix)
  • Familiarity with NoSQL technologies (DynamoDB) and event-driven cloud architectures (queues, serverless compute, data streaming)
  • Solid understanding of OOP, design patterns, and architectural best practices
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams
  • Passion for building reliable, scalable systems with a focus on customer impact
  • BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Advanced English proficiency

Bonus

  • Experience in shipping or logistics

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry – Nexer Telescope

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry role at Nexer Telescope. Sweden needs skilled engineers, and we are looking for a senior headhunter to help find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry role at Nexer Telescope

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope\'s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Required competence

At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.

  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a \'no\' as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.

Contract and Location

Full time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex. Location: You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice. Economy: Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

The Cloud Engineer position at Metal Toad requires experience in designing and maintaining infrastructure for high-availability, scalable, enterprise-grade applications. You will be part of a talented team that works on mission-critical applications.

Responsibilities

  • Planning — Analyzing customer requirements for software components, system availability, security, and performance; designing and documenting complete cloud hosting systems, including capacity planning software and instance type selection, allocation, and network design; estimating the costs of the recommended system design; building systems by executing installation, configuration, and testing of cloud resources; using automation and configuration management to ensure repeatability and traceability of changes.

Qualifications

  • Read and agree to our Corporate Values Statement.
  • Believe in the company's mission: to help people.
  • Advanced to fluent English communication skills are essential.
  • 2+ years of experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Additional experience with other cloud providers is a bonus.
  • Experience with Linux and/or Windows Systems administration (at least one required).
  • Scripting (bash and Python preferred; PowerShell acceptable).
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP networking and HTTP protocols.
  • Experience with web accelerators, load balancers, reverse proxies, and CDNs.
  • Problem solver and able to work in an agile/fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-oriented with good communication skills.
  • Willing to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation with approximately one shift per month (compensation included).

Nice to have

  • AWS Certifications or willingness to become certified.
  • Interest in Generative AI technologies.

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry — role at Nexer Telescope

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are high by international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope\'s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Find engineers who are ready to relocate to Sweden.
  • Inform candidates about benefits of living and working in Sweden and build trust through the recruitment process.
  • Coordinate with a global team of recruiters and Sweden-based management to support relocation logistics.
  • Collaborate with clients in software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.
  • Plan and execute recruiting activities with colleagues across multiple countries.

Required competence

At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.

  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.

title: QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services
description:
QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a QA Engineer Specialist in our BASE area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models. In this role, you will go beyond testing — you will drive quality across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping automation frameworks, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.
As a Q.A. Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of the quality of the most critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the very beginning of the product lifecycle, helping with the product requirements, defining and building comprehensive test scenarios, performing in-depth exploratory testing, and automating mission-critical flows. Your work will ensure backward compatibility, performance, reliability, and overall product excellence.In addition, you will define and continuously improve the testing pipeline, driving best practices in automated testing and mentoring developers to elevate the team’s quality standards.
This role combines strong analytical QA expertise with engineering skills in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from overall test planning to execution.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the design and implementation of test strategies (manual, automated, and exploratory) for complex distributed systems.
  • Define and evolve quality standards, frameworks, and processes across multiple services.
  • Mentor and guide software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership for quality.
  • Partner with product managers and engineering leaders to assess risks, define acceptance criteria, and shape solutions.
  • Drive test automation adoption, building scalable frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Champion performance, load, and reliability testing as part of the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality gates and CI/CD pipelines provide fast, reliable feedback to teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues and propose improvements in architecture, tooling, and processes.
  • Act as a quality advocate, ensuring we deliver not just working software, but trusted and delightful experiences to users.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A QA professional with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in QA Engineering, with a strong background in automation (Cypress, Playwright, Rest-assured, SuperTest, Bruno, Cucumber, Postman, or similar).
  • Experienced with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and data validations in SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Familiar with cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred but not required experience in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, Locust, K6) and their application to large-scale systems.
  • Experienced in risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and working with distributed systems.
  • Solid experience working with distributed systems using asynchronous communication (Kafka)
  • Familiar with SQL, being able to navigate complex data domains
  • Comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, influencing quality practices, and driving alignment on testing strategies.
  • Solid communication skills in English, able to articulate quality goals, trade-offs, and improvements across cultures and geographies.
  • A proactive, collaborative problem-solver who sees quality as a shared responsibility across engineering.
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, NewRelic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana Loki, or similar).
  • Preferred but not required experience with contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, Dredd, or similar).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in QA Engineering, automation test, API testing, and distributed systems using asynchronous communicationare mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

description:
Overview

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry – role at Nexer Telescope.

Sweden needs skilled engineers. About 30,000 of them by 2030, according to Statistics Sweden. We currently have about 200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. This role is to help us find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden and inform them about the benefits of living and working there.

As a senior headhunter, you will be part of a global recruiting team and collaborate with an executive management team in Sweden. You will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team for relocation logistics, including visa, work permits, travel, housing, and related arrangements. We fix everything for our employees – visa, work permits, tickets, housing, and more.

Clients are in software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed with colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team that aims to help engineers and their families build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope’s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

As a senior headhunter, you will:

  • Help find engineers who are ready to relocate to Sweden.
  • Inform candidates about the benefits of living and working in Sweden.
  • Build trust with suitable candidates during the relocation process.
  • Collaborate with a global team of recruiters and the Swedish delivery management team for relocation logistics.
  • Coordinate with clients in multiple sectors including software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, and online solutions.

Required competence

Please ensure this is documented in your CV:

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well-proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset toward finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and IT outstaffing/outsourcing concepts.
  • Upper-intermediate English.
  • Knowledge of contemporary IT technologies and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Analytical, well organized with attention to detail, and able to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self-confident, friendly, outgoing, and highly self-motivated.
  • Persistent and resilient, able to handle “no” and persevere.
  • Passionate about success with an executive yet relaxed attitude toward work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible with a professional appearance.

Extent & Duration

Start ASAP. Full-time. Long-term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

Location

Work from home or from a co-location center of your choice.

Economy

Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

title: Ferramenteiro Jr
description:
Descrição

Realiza a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em moldes
de injeção plástica, por meio do auxílio na desmontagem, substituição, reparo e
montagem dos mesmos, tendo em vista a disponibilidade operacional dos
equipamentos.

Organiza e efetua a limpeza do local e ferramentas de
trabalho.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realiza a manutenção
preventiva/corretiva de moldes, através da avaliação do tempo de uso e
desgaste dos mesmos, montagem e desmontagem, bem como a realização de
troca de componentes e peças, a fim de aumentar a vida útil dos mesmos,
bem como reduzir o índice de quebras. Realiza alinhamento de moldes e
setups. Realiza leitura de desenhos
técnicos mecânicos. Manuseia instrumentos de
medição diversos (paquímetro, micrômetro e afins). Comunica ao superior imediato
sobre possíveis ocorrências, como defeito nas máquinas e equipamentos e
outras irregularidades, através da realização de vistoria, a fim de sanar
as falhas identificadas. Utiliza os materiais,
instrumentos e equipamentos de trabalho de maneira correta, por meio do
manuseio dos mesmos de acordo com as normas e procedimentos definidos, a
fim de conservar os materiais. Conserva os materiais, por meio
da higienização e correta armazenagem dos mesmos, a fim de evitar avarias
e extravios. Realiza limpeza de máquinas,
equipamentos, ferramentas, por meio da observação de resíduos, óleo, água,
entre outros e higienização das impurezas encontradas, tendo em vista
zelar pelo bom estado e conservação dos mesmos. Conhece e aplica os requisitos
de Boas Práticas de Fabricação de acordo com a legislação aplicável,
cumprindo os procedimentos internos em seu setor. Participa de treinamentos
relacionados aos procedimentos de BPF. Reporta
problemas relacionados a desvios de BPF ao superior imediato para tomada
de ações, contribuindo para a erradicação das não conformidades; Participar da investigação da anomalia de SST,
quando designado; Quando ocorrer; Garantir que os riscos sejam reduzidos ao
menor nível razoavelmente possível (níveis aceitáveis conforme definidos
na matriz de risco). Contínuo;  Cumprir
com as ações e procedimentos determinados para implantar requisitos
legais; Contínuo. Para NR 12: A função citada
está autorizada à intervenção e desenvolvimento de atividades com os
equipamentos dentro do seu limite de atuação conforme especificação da sua
LPR. Para NR
11: Foi autorizado utilizar, em formato de painel, as informações
(conforme imagem abaixo) no equipamento de movimentação de carga.

Requisitos e qualificações

Curso Técnico em Usinagem, Ferramentaria, Tecnologia
Mecânica ou afins.

title: SUPERVISOR – SHOPPING CENTER
description:
Gestão da equipe:
Supervisionar e distribuir as tarefas diárias entre os membros da equipe de limpeza.Treinar e orientar os funcionários quanto às técnicas de limpeza, uso de produtos e equipamentos adequados.Avaliar o desempenho da equipe, fornecendo feedback e fazendo ajustes quando necessário.

Controle de materiais e produtos de limpeza:
Verificar o estoque de materiais e solicitar a reposição quando necessário.Garantir que os produtos utilizados sejam adequados para os ambientes e superfícies a serem limpas.Acompanhar o uso dos materiais, para evitar desperdícios.

Elaborar cronogramas e planos de limpeza, definindo a frequência de limpeza para diferentes áreas (diária, semanal, etc.).Identificar áreas que exigem limpeza especial ou mais detalhada, como banheiros, áreas comuns, etc.

Garantir que as normas de higiene e segurança sejam seguidas por todos os colaboradores.Verificar a qualidade do serviço de limpeza, inspecionando as áreas e corrigindo falhas quando necessário.

Relacionamento com outros departamentos:
Coordenar com outros setores, como a administração e recursos humanos, para garantir que a limpeza esteja em conformidade com as necessidades dos demais colaboradores.Receber solicitações de limpeza específicas e dar andamento a essas demandas.

Gestão de segurança:
Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, principalmente no que diz respeito ao uso de produtos químicos e equipamentos de limpeza.Providenciar o uso de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados para a equipe.

Essas são algumas das principais atividades de um supervisor de limpeza. O cargo exige habilidades de liderança, organização e conhecimento dos processos de limpeza e segurança no trabalho.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You’ll Do

  • Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
  • Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.
  • Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.
  • Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team’s dataset roadmap to power Speechify’s next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
  • Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products.
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive.
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity.
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry.
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture.
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more.

Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho (BA)

Cidade: Camacari - Bahia

Resumo

Identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos em todas as fases do ciclo de vida de um processo. Isso inclui a realização de estudos como HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study), LOPA (Layer of Protection Analysis), e Bow-Tie Analysis.

Responsabilidades
  • Avaliar e aprovar qualquer alteração em processos, equipamentos, matérias-primas ou procedimentos operacionais para garantir que a segurança não seja comprometida. Isso é vital, pois muitas vezes acidentes são causados por mudanças mal planejadas.
  • Liderar a investigação de eventos de segurança, utilizando metodologias como a Análise de Causa Raiz (Root Cause Analysis - RCA), para identificar as falhas e implementar ações corretivas e preventivas eficazes.
  • Conduzir auditorias regulares e inspeções de segurança para verificar a conformidade com as normas internas, regulamentos governamentais e boas práticas da indústria.
  • Colaborar na criação e revisão de procedimentos operacionais e de emergência, garantindo que as equipes saibam como agir de forma segura em qualquer situação.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos sobre segurança de processos para todos os funcionários, desde a equipe de operação até a gerência, para fomentar uma cultura de segurança robusta.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho de segurança (Key Performance Indicators - KPIs) para avaliar a eficácia do programa de segurança de processos e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de segurança crítica, como P&ID's (Diagramas de Tubulação e Instrumentação), manuais de operação e relatórios de análise de risco.

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. Gestão de pessoas, processos, budget, prazos, produtos e insumos.

Gerenciamento da unidade, time, resultados, organização e bom funcionamento.

Nosso objetivo é encontrar alguém que seja apaixonado por impulsionar resultados e liderar equipes rumo ao sucesso. title: Supervisor de Unidade
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

Fundado em Brasília pelas bioquímicas Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, o Grupo Sabin está há 38 anos no mercado. Somos referência em Medicina Diagnóstica, com atuação em análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, vacinação e check-up executivo. O Sabin também atua em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS) com a Amparo Saúde e lançou, no ano passado, a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde Rita Saúde. Somos reconhecidos no Brasil e na América Latina como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar há mais de 18 anos, com cultura organizacional forte, respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão. Contamos com mais de 6.700 colaboradores, em 12 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 323 unidades.

Responsibilities
  • Planejar e administrar o trabalho da equipe, definindo rotinas, técnicas de abordagem de clientes e estratégias para cumprir metas e prazos;
  • Supervisionar todas as rotinas administrativas da equipe;
  • Supervisionar serviços gerais de malotes, mensageiros, transporte, limpeza, terceirizados, manutenção de equipamento, mobiliário e instalações;
  • Responder pelas metas e resultados da equipe, traçando planos de avanço e de melhoria contínua;
  • Monitorar os indicadores da área;
  • Planejar e desenvolver novos projetos, quando aplicável;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento, informações e metas com toda a equipe;
  • Controlar as atividades financeiras das unidades;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes, mercado e médicos;
  • Realizar mapeamento de mercado local e fechar parcerias para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Gerenciar o clima organizacional, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo;
  • Promover feedbacks de forma respeitosa;
  • Sinalizar casos de baixa performance à gestão de pessoal;
  • Realizar desligamentos junto ao RH, quando aplicável;
  • Assegurar que as políticas e normas da empresa sejam cumpridas pela equipe;
  • Desenvolver novos лидеры quando aplicável;
  • Propor ações de melhoria contínua;
Qualifications
  • Graduação completa em Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas da Saúde;
  • Desejável especialização em Gestão em Saúde, Administração Hospitalar ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em Boas Práticas Laboratoriais, biossegurança e protocolos de qualidade;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em cargos de liderança em serviços de saúde;
  • Experiência na implementação de processos, protocolos de qualidade e auditorias;
  • Curso de Auditor PALC será um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado será considerado um diferencial;
  • Etapas do processo seletivo incluem entrevista com o gestor.
About Sabin

Referência em saúde, destacada pela gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, o Grupo Sabin nasceu em Brasília há décadas, fruto da coragem de duas empreendedoras. Hoje, conta com cerca de 7.000 colaboradores, presente em 14 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 354 unidades, oferecendo serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental. O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo, além de serviços de atenção primária com a Amparo Saúde e a plataforma Rita Saúde, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência. Em 2020, foi lançado o SkyHub.Bio, hub de inovação para promoção e desenvolvimento de startups na saúde. O Grupo mantém o Instituto Sabin, criado em 2005 para ações de impacto social, que já beneficiou mais de 1,6 milhão de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos e vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin pelo Brasil. Investimos em processos formulados para atrair pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

Fique atento e evite golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.

Gerente de Logística - Salvador/BA na MadeiraMadeira . A MadeiraMadeira acredita no poder de reinventar casas, histórias e, principalmente, pessoas. Aqui, crescer é parte da jornada. Acreditamos em um estilo de liderança que vai além de títulos ou posições. Nossos líderes são movidos por uma ambição feroz pelo sucesso coletivo, atuando com responsabilidade, visão de longo prazo e foco em criar um legado duradouro. Aqui, liderar é desenvolver pessoas, promover o crescimento sustentável do time e valorizar as contribuições de todos. Buscamos líderes dispostos a aprender constantemente, que reconhecem o valor do trabalho em equipe e têm coragem para tomar decisões difíceis quando necessário, sempre com empatia, ética e compromisso com os Princípios de Liderança da MadeiraMadeira.
